pairs.subject: cross-instance-cache-lease
pairs.evidence: packages/kernel/src/lease-core.ts:162 The code grants exclusive execution rights only when the resource is free; context and repository searches found exclusion heartbeats and durable outputs, but no result-retention lease for a waiting peer collector.

techniques.evidence: packages/kernel/src/lease.ts:234 This checks an exclusion heartbeat using the transaction timestamp, rather than receiving a peer's cache-retention deadline.
packages/kernel/src/lease-core.ts:184 Heartbeats belong to the current exclusive grant; this is not a retained result renewed by collectors.
packages/kernel/src/job-run.ts:174 The driver claims an execution slot when starting work; queued jobs do not depend on a peer retaining a leased result.
packages/kernel/src/job-run.ts:332 Results are persisted as job outputs, rather than held in an expiring cache awaiting peer collection.
